author: darl
message:
ytpoolctl: simplify Phase 3 reconciler wiring

Behavior-preserving cleanup of the YTPool controller code:
- factory.go: dedupe the client-TTL default (apply once, after options,
  so a zero/negative WithClientTTL also falls back to 30m)
- ytpool_controller.go: replace opaque review-tracker tags in comments
  with plain-language explanations (auth-retry, deletion path)
- main.go: explain why the shared http.Client pool is reused across
  per-namespace clients

No exported signatures, struct fields, interfaces, or error/log
message semantics changed. Verified: ya make -r controllers/ytpool Ok;
reconciler gotest 13/13 GOOD; client gotest 30/30 GOOD.
